# Nour Adhkar

Nour Adhkar is a Persian-first Islamic supplications website and Android app. It provides Arabic adhkar with Persian, Arabic, and Sorani translations, source references, audio, and informational articles.

## Public lecture library

- https://adhkar.ir/lectures — browse the currently published lecture catalog by scholar.
- https://adhkar.ir/lectures/ziaei — published audio lectures by Sheikh Ziaei.
- https://adhkar.ir/lectures/pordel — published audio lectures by Sheikh Mohammad Saleh Pordel.
- https://adhkar.ir/lectures/khatibi — published audio lectures by Sheikh Abdulrahim Khatibi.

Lecture pages contain catalog descriptions and audio players. Audio is served from Nour Adhkar's own API host at api.adhkar.ir. The public catalog can change; the website lists records currently published there and does not claim to represent private, unpublished, deleted, or historical archive files.

## Key URLs

- https://adhkar.ir/ — homepage and app features
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/sobhgahi — morning adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/shamgahi — evening adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/istikhara — istikhara prayer
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/ramadan — Ramadan adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/blog — Islamic supplication articles
- https://adhkar.ir/app — Android app information and download links
- https://adhkar.ir/about — about Nour Adhkar

## Entities

- Organization: Nour Adhkar
- SoftwareApplication: Nour Adhkar Android App
- WebSite: adhkar.ir
- Blog: Persian articles about Islamic supplications
